title: Solar photovoltaic manufacturing in Africa: opportunity or mirage?
publisher: Africa Policy Research Institute (APRI), Green & Transition Minerals Collection
summary: Africa holds key minerals for solar PV production, such as copper, tin and silicon, but most countries on their own lack the finance, technological capabilities and infrastructure to build a competitive PV manufacturing sector. The paper finds only scattered opportunities for local manufacturing and recommends a regionalised PV strategy to integrate into the global solar value chain.
keyFindings: Opportunities for local solar PV manufacturing within African countries are scattered.
Entering the global value chain is hard given market concentration, high entry barriers and established players, with China dominant in nearly every segment.
Without a coordinated regional approach, individual countries are unlikely to integrate into the global market.
